Use WeCP’s AI Copilot for Efficient Hiring
WeCP's AI Copilot is intended to improve and expedite the hiring process. Recruiters are enabled to make informed judgments based on the performance of the candidate and efficiently hire exceptional people, from prospect screening to scheduling interviews.
Enhancing Existing Employee Skills with WeCP’s AI Copilot
Through AI-powered insights and tailored learning suggestions, companies may enable their employees to gain skills and maintain a competitive edge in the fast-growing competitive market.
Support
FAQs
Everything you need to know about the product and functionality. Can’t find the answer you’re looking for? Please chat to our team.
Will these questions actually test real skills needed?
Yes - that's the core purpose. Our system utilizes the latest natural language processing to deeply understand job requirements and map them to appropriate coding challenges, theoretical questions, and competency areas to vet. The human review step also ensures relevance.
How do I know the questions will be fair and unbiased?
Bias mitigation and ethical AI are priorities. Our question generation models are trained with techniques like adversarial debiasing to eliminate unfair biases. Humans vet again for any concerning language. We're committed to inclusive, non-discriminatory assessments.
Will the AI actually understand the nuances of the roles I'm hiring for?
Absolutely. Our AI has been trained on millions of job descriptions and requirements across industries. It uses advanced natural language processing to deeply comprehend the skills, competencies, responsibilities etc. for each role you input. The generated questions will be highly tailored and relevant.
How customizable are the AI-generated questions? I like to add my own personal touch.
You have full control to customize as much or as little as you like. The AI provides an initial high-quality base. From there, you can edit the question text, add your own test cases and examples, adjust the difficulty level, or restructure the questions entirely to fit your personal assessment style.
I'm not very technical myself. Will I be able to properly vet coding questions?
You don't need to be an expert programmer. We provide clear, human-readable expected solutions and test cases along with each generated code question. This annotated reference solution enables you to easily validate a candidate's work even if you aren't fluent in that language.
